title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: protect Recall snapshots on Copilot+ PCs
summary: The documented controls, licensing and roadmap facts support publication. Minor corrections should explicitly flag the Recall DLP restriction's preview designation in Learn and remove device-scoping instructions that have no matching control row.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Endpoint DLP can audit or block sensitive content in Recall snapshots on Copilot+ PCs.
claims.quote: Restrictions in Windows Recall in Copilot+ PCs > Restrict content in Windows Recall. You can select Audit only or Block.
claims.fix: Add after the first sentence of What's changing: 'The roadmap records this change as Launched with release phase General Availability, while Microsoft's DLP policy reference still marks the Recall restriction as in preview.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-policy-reference#rules. Keep the roadmap fields unchanged.

claims.claim: DLP protection requires configuring both the Purview policy and the device's DLP provider.
claims.quote: Set the following Group Policy settings on the Copilot+ PC to enable DLP protections for Recall using either Microsoft Intune or Local Group Policy Editor.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Restrict content in Windows Recall offers Audit only and Block.
claims.quote: You can select Audit only or Block.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Audit only does not notify the user when a snapshot contains sensitive information.
claims.quote: If you select Audit only, then the user doesn't see any notification when a snapshot is taken that contains sensitive information.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Audit only logs the sensitive snapshot event in DLP reports.
claims.quote: However, the event is logged in the DLP reports.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Block excludes the sensitive content from a snapshot.
claims.quote: If you select Block, then when a snapshot is taken that contains sensitive information, then the sensitive content isn't included in the snapshot.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Recall DLP enforcement removes the particular windows identified by the provider as blocked.
claims.quote: DLP enforcement is applied at the window level—Recall removes only the specific window(s) identified by the DLP provider as containing sensitive data blocked by policy

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Window-level DLP enforcement retains the rest of the snapshot.
claims.quote: while retaining the rest of the snapshot.
